objective: 사용자의 가치관과 견해가 드러나는 상위 서비스 서사의 자기소개서 5세트를 만들고, 보편 용어·문장 추적성·평가 신뢰 한계를 반영한 평가체계에서 90점 이상인 세트만 PDF에 포함한다.
correctionsFromV3: 의도·여정·공유 맥락·근거·불확실성·서비스 약속처럼 독자가 프로젝트 내부 의미를 복원해야 하는 표현을 canonical domain language로 교체
저장소 근거 경로의 drift를 확인하고 packages/shared/README.md를 현재의 shared/README.md로 정정
평가축을 사람 중심 서사·직무 적합성·근거 인과·도메인 언어 명료성·전달 방어의 5개 domain으로 재구성
평가자·사용자 확인·사후 결과·점수 자체를 서로 다른 데이터로 보존하고 score confidence를 editorial comparison only로 제한
criterion anchor와 counter-evidence를 추가해 5개 초안의 차이를 관찰 가능한 문장으로 판별
정확한 문장 주소·근거·한계를 claim ledger에 연결하고 undefined critical term, canonical coverage, pairwise separation, sensitivity를 추가
Q3의 사용자 제공 가치 문구는 모두 유지하되 동일 문장 반복을 제거하고 판단 대상·회사 행동을 세트별로 다르게 구성

excluded: automated selection of the user's true value system

stages.name: purpose_context_and_user_boundary
checks: evaluand is one three-answer set
consumer is draft editor
90 threshold and five-set minimum fixed
user-provided value separated from editorial interpretation
stages.exit: construct, consumer, user boundary and evidence classes bound

stages.name: official_role_and_project_abstraction
checks: official role scope separated from repository facts
project expressed as user goal→work context→service processing→result verification→improvement
personal contribution and outcome gaps preserved

stages.name: canonical_language_freeze
checks: universal terms preferred over project/team terms
one concept-one term mapping fixed
critical abstract words defined or replaced
reader can identify actor/action/object/criterion

stages.name: construct_and_profile_freeze
checks: five domain weights sum to 100
all criteria have observable anchors and counter-evidence
nine protected gates precede weighted score
ordinal transformation and unknown states recorded

stages.name: five_set_generation
checks: all 15 answers 300~700 characters
Q1 includes knowledge/skill and workplace expression
Q2 includes type/scale/role/contribution/process/learning
Q3 includes direct value and workplace realization
each set has a distinct viewpoint

stages.name: semantic_claim_and_contrastive_review
checks: no low-level implementation exposition in essay center
past/future/evidence classes separated
all core terms map to canonical concepts
no unsupported operational outcome
exact duplicate Q3 core sentence rate zero
close pair is explicitly reviewed
stages.exit: known hard failures rewritten or excluded

stages.name: scoring_discrimination_and_sensitivity
checks: all gates pass
criterion anchors used
weighted score arithmetic independently recalculated
pairwise separation and criterion spread recorded
weight-sensitivity ranking recorded
only score >=90 included
stages.exit: five included sets selected under baseline profile

stages.name: render_and_independent_validation
checks: all JSON parses
character counts and scores visible
PDF page layout has no overflow
content, arithmetic, provenance and render checks are separate
score caveat is visible
stages.exit: PDF and machine-readable v4 artifacts ready

stages.name: user_semantic_review
checks: user confirms or edits viewpoint wording
user confirms personal contribution and project facts
user selects among close pair if needed
stages.exit: pending_user_review can become accepted or revised

dataOperations.unknownPolicy: unavailable/conflicting/pending_user_review/not_applicable remain explicit and never become zero or pass
dataOperations.lifecycle: draft -> language_bound -> profile_resolved -> evidence_ready -> gated -> evaluated -> selected -> user_review -> accepted_or_revised

followUpForApplicant: 다섯 세트의 중심 관점 중 실제 본인의 견해와 가장 가까운 문장을 표시하고 어색한 표현을 수정
collab-mono에서 실제로 변경한 영역·결정·대안·검증 실행·배포 사실을 claim ledger에 확정
날짜가 있는 테스트·배포·장애·성과가 있다면 해당 문장에만 과거형으로 추가
면접 대비를 위해 프로젝트에서 실패한 선택과 버린 대안을 하나씩 준비
set-2 문장을 소리 내어 읽고 독자가 한 번에 이해하지 못하는 용어가 있는지 확인
